questions.question:

• The statement has **'certain'** which is an **adverb** since it gives an affirmative tone to the sentence. it is also known **adverb of affirmation**.

• Affect is a **verb** and **effect **is a **noun **usually. Affect stands for **action**.

• Lack of sleep **affected**__ her performance on the IQ test.

 __

questions.question: If x is subtracted from each of 52, 47, 20 and 19, the number so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 13) and (x - 8)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For numbers a, b, c, d to be in proportion when x is subtracted: x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c))

Here, a = 52, b = 47, c = 20, d = 19

x = (52 × 19 − 47 × 20) ÷ ((52 + 19) − (47 + 20)) = (988 − 940) ÷ (71 − 67) = 48 ÷ 4 = 12

Mean proportional between (x + 13) and (x − 8) = √((12 + 13) × (12 − 8)) = √(25 × 4) = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 52, 47, 20, 19

When x is subtracted from each, they become proportional.

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d.

Mean proportional between two numbers p and q = √(p × q)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4d3826141a9fdd439c4410d6fbe8fa43baf6014e65dc5053757c47b7ae57d90.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (52 − x) : (47 − x) :: (20 − x) : (19 − x)

⇒ (52 − x) ÷ (47 − x) = (20 − x) ÷ (19 − x)

⇒ (52 − x)(19 − x) = (20 − x)(47 − x)

⇒ 988 − 52x − 19x + x² = 940 − 20x − 47x + x²

⇒ 988 − 71x = 940 − 67x

⇒ 71x − 67x = 988 − 940

⇒ 4x = 48

⇒ x = 12

Now, finding the given terms to calculate the mean proportional:

⇒ First term = (x + 13) = 12 + 13 = 25

⇒ Second term = (x − 8) = 12 − 8 = 4

⇒ Mean proportional = √(25 × 4) = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b). It represents the value x such that a : x :: x : b.

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportional to a and b. Formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional is x such that a : b :: c : x. Formula: x = (b × c) ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then applying Componendo and Dividendo gives (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d). This rule is widely used to simplify complex ratios.

questions.question: A boy walked along two adjacent sides of a rectangular field. If he had walked along the diagonal, then he would have saved a distance equal to one-fourth of the larger side. The ratio of the larger to the smaller side is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let **larger side** be L and **smaller side** be B.

Distance saved = (L + B) − √(L² + B²) = L/4

⇒ √(L² + B²) = 3L/4 + B

Squaring both sides: L² + B² = 9L²/16 + B² + 3LB/2

⇒ 7L²/16 = 3LB/2 ⇒ 7L/8 = 3B ⇒ L/B = 24/7

**∴ The correct answer is 24 : 7.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Larger side** of **rectangular field** = L

**Smaller side** of **rectangular field** = B

Distance saved = 1/4 × **Larger side** = L/4

**Formula Used:**

**Diagonal** (D) of a **rectangle** = √(L² + B²)

Distance saved = (Sum of **adjacent sides**) − **Diagonal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50b9761e0ea71b05e4d3fa670806060ad4c692783e50eeee8f9b672933298b26.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (L + B) − D = L/4

⇒ D = L + B − L/4

⇒ D = 3L/4 + B

⇒ D² = (3L/4 + B)²

⇒ L² + B² = 9L²/16 + B² + 2 × (3L/4) × B

⇒ L² − 9L²/16 = 3LB/2

⇒ 7L²/16 = 3LB/2

⇒ 7L/16 = 3B/2

⇒ L/B = (3 × 16) ÷ (7 × 2)

⇒ L/B = 48 ÷ 14 = 24 ÷ 7

**∴ The correct answer is 24 : 7.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: H² = P² + B².

Pythagorean Triplets

These are sets of three positive integers (a, b, c) such that a² + b² = c². Common examples include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (7, 24, 25).

Rectangle Properties

questions.question: A person borrows ₹ 75,000 for 3 years at 5% simple interest. He lends it to B at 7% for 3 years. What is his gain (in ₹)?

Net interest rate gain per year = 7% − 5% = 2%

Total gain percentage over 3 years = 2% × 3 = 6%

Gain amount = 6% of Principal (₹75,000)

⇒ Gain = 75,000 × (6 ÷ 100) = ₹4,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,500.**

Principal (P) = ₹75,000

Gain = SI Received − SI Paid

⇒ Total gain = 15,750 − 11,250 = ₹4,500

Simple Interest (SI)

Interest is calculated only on the principal amount throughout the tenure. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest (CI)

Interest is calculated on the principal plus any previously accumulated interest. Amount = P × (1 + R/100)T.

questions.question: The Economic Survey (of India) 2019-20 introduced the idea of “______ as a public good that gets enhanced with greater use.”

• Non-rejectable: Collective supply for all citizens of these goods means that they cannot be rejected.

• And unveiled in advance in order to provide a context of the latter.
 
• Last year the theme was Saving Lives and Livelihoods.
 
• The central theme of Economic Survey 2021-22 is the "Agile Approach".
 
• Another theme highlighted in this Economic Survey relates to the art and science of policy-making under conditions of extreme uncertainty.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the river Ganga?

__
 
• **Tributaries of Ganga:**
 
• **Left Tributaries:**
 
 
• Ramganga, Garra, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Koshi, Mahananda.
 
 
 
• **Right Tributaries**:
 
 
• Yamuna, Tamsa, Son, Punpun, Kiul, Karamnasa, Chandan.
 
 
 
• Hence **Penganga** is NOT a tributary of the river Ganga.
 
• The Penganga River is a tributary of the Wardha River, which is a tributary of the Pranhita River, which flows into the Godavari.

• It is the major tributary of the Ganga river which originates from the Peninsular plateau region.
 
 
 
• **Ramganga** originates from the state of Uttarakhand.
 
 
• The length of the river Ramganga is 596 km
 
• Ramganga is a tributary of the river Ganga.
 
• Ramganga joins Ganga near Kannauj district.
